data.standardized_narrative: Unable to extract definitive gross claims outstanding (opening reserves) or a gross prior-year reserve movement from the provided scanned pages. The report images include financial highlights (showing gross written premium of ~555m for 2018) and many notes, but the specific 'Claims outstanding' (gross) liability line and the 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' gross column were not legible in the supplied images. Consequently the direction and magnitude of prior year development cannot be reliably determined from the supplied pages.
data.data_quality_notes: Document provided as low-resolution scanned images. Key numeric lines requested by the schema ('Claims outstanding' gross figure on the liabilities/technical provisions page and the 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' gross column) are not clearly legible in the images. I was able to read the five-year financial summary (gross written premium ~555.2m for 2018) on the financial highlights page, but could not reliably transcribe the required reserve and prior-year development figures or the regulatory segmental premium breakdown. Returned nulls where authoritative gross reserve or gross prior-year movement figures could not be confirmed. If higher-resolution images or the original PDF text are provided (or the specific pages containing the Balance Sheet technical provisions and the prior-year movement note), I can extract precise numbers and populate the fields with higher confidence.
